title: Software Engineer & Architect (All Genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Flight Control Systems (FCS) Engineering team designs and delivers the hardware, real-time firmware, and flight software that keep STARK's unmanned aerial vehicles stable, responsive, and mission-ready across multiple platforms. We operate as a tight, cross-disciplinary group spanning hardware owners, real-time operating system (RTOS) engineers, guidance and control specialists, systems engineers, and flight test teams. As SW Engineer & Architect, you sit at the technical centre of that group, defining how the software layers fit together and writing core production code alongside your peers. We work close to real hardware on HIL benches and flight ranges, iterating rapidly while holding hard standards for timing, determinism, and flight safety.

YOUR MISSION

You will own the embedded software architecture and core C++ implementation for STARK's modular Flight Control System family across multiple unmanned aerial vehicle platforms. Every architectural boundary you set directly governs flight stability, real-time determinism, and how rapidly STARK brings new airframes and sensor suites from bench prototype to live deployment. Working across hardware, RTOS, guidance, and flight test teams, you will pair disciplined safety-critical engineering with hands-on code delivery under defence-tech pace.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Define and maintain the layered software architecture for STARK's modular Flight Control System family, separating hardware abstraction, RTOS services, middleware, and flight control applications across multiple UAV platforms.
  • Design, implement, debug, and review deterministic, real-time C and modern C++ flight software, covering state machines, task scheduling, fault handling, and sensor-to-actuator data pipelines on microcontroller targets.
  • Author and align interface control documents (ICDs), timing budgets, memory budgets, and failure-mode behaviour with Platform RTOS, FCS Hardware, Guidance and Control, and Systems Engineering teams.
  • Integrate flight software onto target microcontrollers, sensor interfaces, and embedded communication buses (CAN/CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet), isolating root causes on the hardware bench with debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Build testable software boundaries and automated verification gates across unit tests, static analysis, software-in-the-loop (SIL) simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) rigs ahead of ground and live flight trials.
  • Establish pragmatic MISRA-aligned C/C++ coding guidelines and lead architecture and code reviews so the codebase stays maintainable as the FCS engineering team scales.
